On Mon, Feb 28, 2011 at 7:00 AM, The Duke                           wrote:

We have had a discussion this morning and we are somewhat at a loss as to how to
deal with this as it is now innuendo rather than substantive allegations,
notwithstanding anything false they have said about you or Ghislaine.
We are having discreet discussions with the Press Complaints Commission but don't
hold out much hope for a sensible.
We will be writing a lawyers letter to the Mail Group (again) upon the accuracy and
innuendo failures. This is a regular thing and has to be done to register our
displeasure.
No one else has even sparked at the story over here, which is a good thing.
